title: Valid login with standard_user credentials
preconditions: Browser is open, https://www.saucedemo.com is reachable
expected: User is redirected to the product catalog page (/inventory.html)

title: Login fails with incorrect password
preconditions: Browser is open, https://www.saucedemo.com is reachable
expected: Error message 'Epic sadface: Username and password do not match any user in this service' is displayed; user remains on login page

title: Login fails with completely invalid credentials
preconditions: Browser is open, https://www.saucedemo.com is reachable
expected: Error message is displayed; user remains on login page

title: Locked-out user cannot log in
preconditions: Browser is open, https://www.saucedemo.com is reachable
expected: Error message 'Epic sadface: Sorry, this user has been locked out.' is displayed; user remains on login page

title: Login fails when Username field is empty
preconditions: Browser is open, https://www.saucedemo.com is reachable
expected: Error message 'Epic sadface: Username is required' is displayed

title: Login fails when Password field is empty
preconditions: Browser is open, https://www.saucedemo.com is reachable
expected: Error message 'Epic sadface: Password is required' is displayed

title: Login fails when both fields are empty
preconditions: Browser is open, https://www.saucedemo.com is reachable
steps: Leave both Username and Password fields empty
expected: Error message 'Epic sadface: Username is required' is displayed

title: Error message can be dismissed after failed login
preconditions: A failed login attempt has been made and error message is visible
steps: Enter invalid credentials and click Login to trigger an error
Click the X (close) button on the error message
expected: Error message disappears; login form is displayed without error styling

title: Successful logout returns user to login page
preconditions: User is logged in as standard_user
expected: User is redirected to the login page; session is cleared

title: Product catalog loads all items after login
preconditions: User is logged in as standard_user
expected: 6 products are displayed with name, image, description, price, and Add to Cart button for each

title: Sort products by Name A to Z
preconditions: User is logged in and on the product catalog page
steps: Click the sort dropdown (default: 'Name (A to Z)')
Select 'Name (A to Z)' from the dropdown
expected: Products are listed in ascending alphabetical order by name

title: Sort products by Name Z to A
preconditions: User is logged in and on the product catalog page
steps: Select 'Name (Z to A)' from the dropdown
expected: Products are listed in descending alphabetical order by name

title: Sort products by Price Low to High
preconditions: User is logged in and on the product catalog page
steps: Select 'Price (low to high)' from the dropdown
expected: Products are listed in ascending price order; cheapest item appears first

title: Sort products by Price High to Low
preconditions: User is logged in and on the product catalog page
steps: Select 'Price (high to low)' from the dropdown
expected: Products are listed in descending price order; most expensive item appears first

title: Product detail page opens with correct information
preconditions: User is logged in and on the product catalog page
steps: Click on the product name 'Sauce Labs Backpack'
expected: Detail page shows correct product name, image, description, price ($29.99), and Add to Cart button

title: Back button on product detail returns to catalog
preconditions: User is on a product detail page
steps: Click on any product to open its detail page
expected: User is returned to the product catalog page with all items visible

title: Product images load correctly on catalog page
preconditions: User is logged in and on the product catalog page
steps: Observe all product cards on the catalog page
Check that each product has a visible, non-broken image
expected: All 6 product images render without broken image icons or placeholder errors

title: Add a single item to the cart from catalog
preconditions: User is logged in and on the product catalog page; cart is empty
steps: Click 'Add to cart' on the 'Sauce Labs Backpack' product card
Observe the cart icon in the top-right corner
expected: Cart badge appears showing count '1'; the button changes to 'Remove'

title: Add multiple items to the cart and verify badge count
preconditions: User is logged in and on the product catalog page; cart is empty
steps: Click 'Add to cart' on 'Sauce Labs Backpack'
Click 'Add to cart' on 'Sauce Labs Bike Light'
Click 'Add to cart' on 'Sauce Labs Bolt T-Shirt'
expected: Cart badge shows count '3'

title: Cart badge increments correctly with each added item
preconditions: User is logged in and on the product catalog page; cart is empty
steps: Click 'Add to cart' on item 1 — verify badge shows '1'
Click 'Add to cart' on item 2 — verify badge shows '2'
Click 'Add to cart' on item 3 — verify badge shows '3'
expected: Badge count increments by 1 after each add action

title: Remove an item from the catalog page updates badge
preconditions: User is logged in; 'Sauce Labs Backpack' has been added to cart (badge = 1)
steps: Click the 'Remove' button on the 'Sauce Labs Backpack' product card
expected: Cart badge disappears (count = 0); button reverts to 'Add to cart'

title: Cart page shows correct items and totals
preconditions: User has added 'Sauce Labs Backpack' ($29.99) and 'Sauce Labs Bike Light' ($9.99) to the cart
steps: Click the cart icon in the top-right corner
expected: Both items are listed with correct names and prices; item count matches badge

title: Cart persists when navigating back to the catalog
preconditions: User has 2 items in the cart
steps: Add 2 items to the cart (automated setup)
Navigate to the product catalog via 'Continue Shopping' or browser back
Visually confirm the cart badge still shows '2' and items remain in cart
expected: Cart state is preserved across page navigation; badge count unchanged

title: Add to cart from product detail page updates catalog button state
preconditions: User is logged in; cart is empty
steps: Click on 'Sauce Labs Backpack' to open the detail page
Click 'Add to cart' on the detail page
Observe the 'Sauce Labs Backpack' card on the catalog
expected: Product card shows 'Remove' button; cart badge shows '1'

title: Empty cart state is displayed correctly
preconditions: User is logged in; no items have been added to the cart
steps: Click the cart icon without adding any items
expected: Cart page shows an empty state with no items listed; no cart badge visible on the icon
